brief: The town's ORIGINAL lawn and lane birds are all but extinct, and nobody decided that. Their band's cap is `birds.filter(b => !b.plaza).length < 3`, which counts #106's ROOF birds and the belfry flock against them. #113 measured it over 1551 daylight dry samples across 5 seeds: the gate is open 15.3% of the time and held shut by roof birds alone 84.7% of the time, and mean present is 0.06 lawn/lane against 2.66 roof and 1.31 plaza. The predicate is the bug — the roof band has its own roll and its own `ROOF_BIRDS 3` cap, and the plaza band has `b.plaza`, so the ground band should count only its own members. Fix the membership test, then RE-PRICE rather than leaving the old number in place: 3 was chosen when this was the only band, so measure what 3 actually delivers once it means what it says and set the cap from that.
successLooksLike: Mean lawn/lane birds present in daylight rises from HEAD's 0.06 to a number a wide shot can see, quoted as a presence mean over >= 10 seeds x several days with HEAD as the control — and the roof and plaza means barely move, which is what shows you fixed the count and not the world.
avoid: Do not give the ground birds a new source: the band exists, it is only miscounted. This changes how often the roll is reached, so it reshuffles the seeded world — read the census for COLLAPSE, not delta, and replay any stray motion gate on HEAD before believing it.
